item.papon.taco_coupon.tooltip.1: Give it to a Papon. He knows a place.
message.papon.coupon_accepted: Papon reads the Taco Coupon... and sets off for the nearest Taco Truck!
message.papon.coupon_rules: He will only walk while someone is with him. Leave him alone and he sits down to grill.
message.papon.no_trucks_here: Papon squints at the coupon. There are no taco trucks in this dimension.
message.papon.waiting: Papon is waiting at the Taco Truck. The grill is heating up...
bar.papon.receiving: Wandering Papon is reading the Taco Coupon

bar.papon.grilling: Wandering Papon is grilling tacos - stay close to keep him walking (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.packing: Wandering Papon is packing up (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.arrived: Wandering Papon reached the Taco Truck!
title.papon.arrived.subtitle: Papon has arrived.
item.papon.jarrito.tooltip: Fizzy, radioactive, delicious. Papon walks faster after one.
item.papon.jarrito_yellow.tooltip: Do not give this one to Papon.
message.papon.jarrito_full: Papon is already buzzing. Maybe later.
message.papon.jarrito_drink: Papon chugs the Jarrito. He is ZOOMING!
message.papon.jarrito_yellow: Papon does NOT like the yellow one.
message.papon.chancla_woke: Papon wakes up FURIOUS... and keeps walking.

bar.papon.drinking: Wandering Papon is drinking a Jarrito (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.smashing: Wandering Papon did NOT want the yellow one (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.tired: Wandering Papon is out of breath (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.sleeping: Wandering Papon is asleep until morning (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.waking: Wandering Papon is waking up (%s blocks left)
bar.papon.angry: Wandering Papon is FURIOUS (%s blocks left)
message.papon.queued: Papon is waiting in line for his taco. Get in line behind him.
message.papon.vendor_busy: Papon the Taquero is busy. Wait your turn in line.
message.papon.vendor_furious: Papon the Taquero is not taking orders right now.
bar.papon.queued: Taco line - %s ahead of the Wandering Papon
bar.papon.presenting: The Wandering Papon hands over his Taco Coupon...
status.papon.line.papon: In line for tacos: %s ahead of the Wandering Papon
status.papon.line.you: In line for tacos: %s ahead of you
status.papon.line.join: Get in line behind the Wandering Papon. Nobody gets served until you do.

speech.papon.don_pollo.order: ¡Tres tacos de pollo, mi hermano! ¡Con mucha salsa!
speech.papon.don_pollo.order.gloss: Three chicken tacos, my brother! With lots of salsa!
speech.papon.don_pollo.leave: ¡Diablo! ¡Esta salsa está picante, mi hermano! ¡Pica muchísimo!
speech.papon.don_pollo.leave.gloss: Damn! This salsa is spicy, my brother! It burns so much!
speech.papon.don_pollo.phone.gloss: Hello? It's Don Pollo! I'm eating, call me later!
speech.papon.edp445.order: Yo lemme get uhh... twelve tacos bro. Twelve. Go Birds.
speech.papon.edp445.leave: Yo these tacos is heat bro, straight mother fuckin heat bro
speech.papon.badlands_chugs.order: Lemme get a gallon of horchata. Actually... make it two.
speech.papon.badlands_chugs.watch: Hold up. Hold up. Watch this.
speech.papon.reviewbrah.order: Good evening. I'll have the number three, please, and a medium horchata.
speech.papon.reviewbrah.leave: This taco is... simply delicious. I'd give it a %s out of 10.
speech.papon.reviewbrah.signoff: Thanks for joining me, everyone. Have a good evening.
speech.papon.vendor.inspect.gloss: A coupon? Let's see, let's see...
speech.papon.vendor.suspicious: Mmm... esto no se ve bien...
speech.papon.vendor.fraud.gloss: A FAKE COUPON?! FRAUD! NOBODY STEALS MY TACOS!
speech.papon.wandering.present: ¡Un taco, por favor! Tengo un cupón.
speech.papon.wandering.present.gloss: One taco, please! I have a coupon.
item.papon.tequila.tooltip: Liquid courage. Chef Papon drinks it by the handle.
item.papon.caravan_keys.tooltip: The keys to a 2001 Dodge Caravan. It has a lot of miles on it.
item.papon.caravan_keys.tooltip2: Use on the ground to park it. Sneak-use on it to pocket it.
message.papon.van_no_room: No room to park a van there.
message.papon.van_wrong_keys: These are not the keys to this van.
message.papon.gerbin_busy: Gerbin is busy. The dishes will not wash themselves.
message.papon.gerbin_scared: Gerbin is hiding behind the counter.
title.papon.boss.subtitle: El Calvo del Taco
status.papon.handle: He is downing a handle by his van. Get off the road!
death.attack.papon.caravan: %1$s was run over by %2$s in a 2001 Dodge Caravan
death.attack.papon.caravan.player: %1$s was run over by a 2001 Dodge Caravan while fighting %2$s
death.attack.papon.spatula: %1$s was flipped like a tortilla by %2$s
speech.papon.vendor.unmask.gloss: You want the truth? HERE IS THE TRUTH!
speech.papon.boss.intro: ¡Nadie ve mi calva y vive para contarlo!
speech.papon.boss.intro.gloss: Nobody sees my bald head and lives to tell!
speech.papon.boss.taunt0.gloss: I'm going to make tacos out of you!
speech.papon.boss.taunt1: ¡Mi calva brilla más que tu futuro!
speech.papon.boss.taunt1.gloss: My bald head shines brighter than your future!
speech.papon.boss.keys.gloss: Where did I leave the keys...? Ah, here!
speech.papon.boss.handle.gloss: One little sip for the road...
speech.papon.edp445.fistbump: Hell yeah my brotha, lets go get some cupcakes!
title.papon.dome.subtitle: Welcome to his pocket
speech.papon.boss.haymaker.gloss: I told you I was fine!
status.papon.heat: Habanero %s/%s: get out of the fire!
status.papon.burrito: You're a burrito! Here he comes.
status.papon.drunk: He took a swig: get out of reach, it can't be stopped!
title.papon.coliseum.subtitle: Where challengers get mashed
speech.papon.boss.apology: My apologies, amigo. Such poor hospitality... making my guest wait like that.
entity.papon.arena_portal: Way Back to El Coliseo Papa
status.papon.composure: He shrugs it off! Raw damage won't do it: beat his mechanics.
status.papon.meteor: IT FALLS! Get to the wall and JUMP the shockwaves!
qte.papon.how.3: MASH IT! The hot sauce is coming!
status.papon.masher: EL MACHACADOR! Stand under a hole (the green squares): they MOVE between slams!
speech.papon.band.sigh: *suspiro* Siempre lo mismo con este señor...
speech.papon.gerbin.pillow: u-um... this is for you. for winning. don't tell the boss.
item.papon.body_pillow.tooltip.0: A present from Gerbin, for beating the boss.
item.papon.body_pillow.tooltip.1: Hold use: hug her. Sneak + use: lick. Look down + use: ...you know.
message.papon.body_pillow.0: You hug the pillow. It smells faintly of dish soap.
message.papon.body_pillow.1: You hug the pillow. Somewhere, Gerbin smiles.
message.papon.body_pillow.3: You hug the pillow. You feel strangely obedient.
message.papon.pillow_given: Gerbin hands you a Makima body pillow. He will not make eye contact.
message.papon.pillow_note: A Makima body pillow turns up in your bag, with a note: "from gerbin :)"
item.papon.body_pillow.tooltip.2: Use on a bed: she sits up against the headboard. Right-click her from the foot or either side of the bed (jump: change position).
message.papon.body_pillow.bed: You lay her down on her side of the bed.
message.papon.body_pillow.bed_taken: This bed is already spoken for.
message.papon.body_pillow.lick.3: The fabric is now forty percent you.
speech.papon.vendor.friend.greet.gloss: FRIEND! My champion! No hard feelings, eh?
speech.papon.vendor.friend.free: Para ti, los tacos son gratis. ¡Para siempre!
speech.papon.vendor.friend.free.gloss: For you, the tacos are free. Forever!
message.papon.vendor.wait: ¡Un momento, amigo! One taco at a time.
status.papon.line.free: Chef Papon: free tacos for his champion, forever. Right-click him for the menu.
menu.papon.tacos.title: EL MENÚ DE PAPÓN
menu.papon.tacos.subtitle: ¡Todo gratis para mi campeón!
menu.papon.tacos.footer: No coupons accepted. Especially not fake ones.
title.papon.para_siempre.subtitle: El Último Baile
status.papon.ola: ¡LA OLA! The salsa is coming: JUMP it!
status.papon.stampede: ¡ESTAMPIDA! Stand in the gaps between the potatoes!
speech.papon.boss2.bleed: Heh heh... You made me BLEED, amigo.
speech.papon.boss2.despierten: WAKE UP, you lazy bums! We have an AUDIENCE!
speech.papon.boss2.momentito: One moment, amigo. Just ONE moment.
speech.papon.boss2.apology: My apologies, amigo. Such POOR hospitality... making my guest wait like that.
speech.papon.boss2.intro: Nobody sees my bald head and LIVES to tell!
speech.papon.boss2.taunt0: I am going to make TACOS out of YOU!
speech.papon.boss2.taunt1: My bald head shines BRIGHTER than your FUTURE!
speech.papon.boss2.keys: Where did I leave the keys? AH! Here!
speech.papon.boss2.handle: One little sip for the road...
speech.papon.boss2.dodge: HA! You didn't even TOUCH me!
speech.papon.boss2.haymaker: I TOLD you I was FINE!!!
speech.papon.boss2.vendor_inspect: A coupon? Let me see, let me SEE...
speech.papon.boss2.vendor_suspicious: Hmm... this does NOT look right.
speech.papon.boss2.vendor_fraud: A FAKE coupon?! FRAUD!!! NOBODY steals MY tacos!
speech.papon.boss2.vendor_unmask: You want the TRUTH? HERE is the truth!
speech.papon.boss2.charm1: Listen to them. They LOVE me.
speech.papon.boss2.charm2: Ay, you are making me sweat, and I am ALREADY baked.
speech.papon.boss2.charm3: Every great potato needs a WORTHY audience.
speech.papon.boss2.charm4: Do not worry. I will make this quick... and BEAUTIFUL.
speech.papon.boss2.hit1: You will PAY for that, in TACOS.
speech.papon.boss2.landed0: Gracias, gracias. You are TOO kind.
speech.papon.boss2.notstyle: This is NOT my style! Who do you think I am?!
speech.papon.boss2.realplay: Let me show you how to REALLY play.
speech.papon.boss2.mystyle: THIS... is more my style. Learn, muchachos.
speech.papon.boss2.go: What are you WAITING for?! GO!!!
speech.papon.boss2.felt: Mmm... I haven't felt like this in a long time.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_solar: BEHOLD... the SUN of my ancestors!!!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_hide: Hide, hide, little potato. The sun sees EVERYTHING.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_mariachi: Maestro! Something with a little more FIRE!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_duel: A DUEL, amigo! Guitar against guitar! Let the crowd decide!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_duel_won: And THAT... is how a legend plays.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_squeeze: Come here. Let me SQUEEZE you like an avocado.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_nova: Feel the heat of a THOUSAND suns... baked into ONE potato!!!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_siesta: Ay... even a god needs a SIESTA...
speech.papon.boss2.p3_nitro: Get in, amigo! Oh, wait... you are the ROAD.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm0: LOUDER! I cannot hear my FANS!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm1: They came to see a GOD tonight, amigo. Not you.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm2: Every star needs a little background dancer.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm3: Smile for the cameras, amigo. This is your LAST show.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm4: Feel that? THAT is what perfection feels like.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm5: Who is your favorite potato?! SAY IT!!!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_landed0: Did you see that?! Did EVERYBODY see that?!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_landed1: Thank you, thank you. I am here all NIGHT.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_low: No, no, no... the show must go ON!
qte.papon.how.5: MASH K and L, one after the other! Fill the bar!
status.papon.solar: THE SUN SEES EVERYTHING. Get behind the car (or in it)!
status.papon.solar_nocar: THE SUN SEES EVERYTHING. Find some shade!
status.papon.mariachi: JUMP the trumpets! DUCK (sneak) under the violins!
status.papon.nova: SUPERNOVA! Get under him, into his shadow!
message.papon.body_pillow.climb: You lay her down and climb on top of her. (Jump: roll her over. Sneak: get off.)
message.papon.body_pillow.hump.1: Gerbin did not raise you for this. Gerbin understands anyway.
message.papon.body_pillow.hump.2: She is folded in half. She does not mind. She is a pillow.
message.papon.body_pillow.hump.3: Somewhere, a mariachi band plays you on.
item.papon.body_pillow.tooltip.3: Sneak + right-click her: sit her on the edge of the bed, feet down (right-click: get down at her feet). Punch her to take her back.
message.papon.body_pillow.edge: You sit her on the edge of the bed. Her feet dangle just off the floor. Right-click her.
message.papon.body_pillow.slouch: You prop her back up against the headboard.
message.papon.body_pillow.no_room: There is no room at her feet. Clear the floor beside the bed.
message.papon.body_pillow.kneel: You get down on the floor at her feet. (Jump: lift her feet to your face. Sneak: get up.)
message.papon.body_pillow.lift: You kneel up and lift her feet to your face. (Jump: back down on the floor.)
message.papon.body_pillow.lower: You set her feet down gently and get back down on the floor.
message.papon.body_pillow.take: You take her back. She does not mind. She is a pillow.
message.papon.body_pillow.feet.1: The stockings taste like dish soap. Gerbin washed them. Gerbin washes everything.
message.papon.body_pillow.feet.2: Gerbin is standing in the doorway. Gerbin says nothing. Gerbin understands.
message.papon.body_pillow.feet.3: You are down at her feet. This is where she wants you. Woof.
message.papon.body_pillow.feet.5: You beat a potato god for this. It was worth it.
message.papon.body_pillow.feet.6: Somewhere, the mariachi band has stopped playing out of respect.
message.papon.body_pillow.feet.7: Her toes are now forty percent you.
message.papon.body_pillow.roll_behind: You roll her over onto her knees and get behind her. (Jump: roll her back.)
message.papon.body_pillow.roll_front: You roll her onto her back and get on top of her again.
message.papon.body_pillow.behind.1: She cannot see your face. Probably for the best.
message.papon.body_pillow.behind.2: The back of the pillow says "Woof." You feel seen.
message.papon.body_pillow.behind.3: Gerbin knocks once and leaves the dish towels outside the door.
message.papon.body_pillow.side: You lay her across the bed and stand at the edge. (Jump: on her knees. Sneak: step away.)
message.papon.body_pillow.side_back: You lay her back across the bed, legs up on your shoulders.
message.papon.body_pillow.side_knees: You put her on her knees at the side of the bed, bent over it. (Jump: on her back.)
message.papon.body_pillow.side.0: Her legs are on your shoulders. Her legs are a pillow.
message.papon.body_pillow.side.1: The bed is exactly the right height. Gerbin measured.
message.papon.body_pillow.side.3: Somewhere, a mariachi band is pretending not to hear this.
message.papon.clarity.title: Post Nut Clarity
message.papon.clarity.0: What am I doing with my life.
message.papon.clarity.1: You beat a potato god. For this.
message.papon.clarity.2: Gerbin washes the pillowcase without a word.
message.papon.clarity.3: You stare at the ceiling. The ceiling stares back.
message.papon.clarity.4: She is a pillow. She was always a pillow.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.1: You look at her and feel nothing. Give it a minute.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.2: The clarity is still upon you.
message.papon.clarity.6: You killed the Final Guardian of the world for a pillow.
message.papon.clarity.7: Papon kept the throne warm for ten thousand years. You kept a pillow warm for thirty seconds.
message.papon.clarity.8: Papon waited ten thousand years for a worthy champion. He got you.
message.papon.clarity.9: The potato prophecy did not mention this part.
message.papon.clarity.10: You slew the Wither, the Warden and the Ender Dragon to craft a taco coupon. Then you did this.
message.papon.clarity.11: Quetzalcóatl and Kukulcán would not be able to look you in the eye.
message.papon.clarity.12: El Gigante dug himself out of the floor of the coliseum for this.
message.papon.clarity.13: El Coliseo Papa stands empty. Thank God.
message.papon.clarity.14: The mariachi band played one last song for him. Nobody will play one for you.
message.papon.clarity.15: Papon died so you could have this. Sit with that.
message.papon.clarity.16: He sang "Para Siempre" to you. You were thinking about a pillow.
message.papon.clarity.17: "Who do you think I AM?!" he screamed. You know who you are now.
message.papon.clarity.18: He called you a worthy warrior. He was wrong.
message.papon.clarity.19: Chef Papon is back at his truck handing out free tacos. You cannot face him.
message.papon.clarity.20: He gave up his throne for a champion to care for the world. The champion is busy.
message.papon.clarity.21: Ignis did a little damage, but nothing notable. Same.
message.papon.clarity.22: The Día de los Muertos moon saw everything. La luna knows.
message.papon.clarity.23: Gerbin picked this gift out for you himself. Gerbin knew.
message.papon.clarity.24: Don Pollo would never. EDP445... maybe.
message.papon.clarity.25: Reviewbrah would give this a two out of ten. Generous.
message.papon.clarity.26: You remember waiting in the taco line. Simpler times.
message.papon.clarity.27: Somewhere a Wandering Papon is grilling tacos alone, and he is a better man than you.
message.papon.clarity.28: You could have kept his Skyline. You chose this.
message.papon.clarity.29: He salted himself golden and screamed to the heavens. You do not even have a scream left.
message.papon.clarity.30: All those QTEs. The guitar duel. The tango. For this.
message.papon.clarity.31: He drank a whole handle of tequila to fight you and still had more dignity.
message.papon.clarity.32: His crowd cheered his name. Yours would go quiet.
message.papon.clarity.33: You dodged El Juicio Final. You could not dodge this feeling.
message.papon.clarity.34: He told you it had been an honor. Imagine if he could see you now.
message.papon.clarity.35: His mustache was fake. Your shame is real.
message.papon.clarity.36: Norwood 7 and proud. You, on the other hand.
message.papon.clarity.37: Somewhere the singer counts off: "Un, dos, tres, cuatro..." For somebody else.
message.papon.clarity.38: You found Makima on a dishwasher's pillowcase. Gerbin found peace.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.3: She is a pillow. You remember that now.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.4: Your body says no. Your soul says no. Gerbin says no.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.5: Papon is watching from the afterlife. Not now.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.6: You reach for her and stop. What would the mariachi band think?
message.papon.clarity.not_now.7: Not until the shame wears off.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.8: You beat the final boss. You cannot beat this.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.9: She can wait. She is a pillow. She has nowhere to be.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.10: The throne he kept warm for centuries. You cannot even keep this up.
message.papon.clarity.not_now.11: Hug her if you must. Just a hug.
message.papon.clarity.sleepless.0: You lie down. You cannot sleep. You can only think about what you did.
message.papon.clarity.sleepless.1: You close your eyes and see his face. Golden. Disappointed.
message.papon.clarity.sleepless.2: Every time you drift off, a mariachi band starts playing.
message.papon.clarity.sleepless.3: Sleep will not come. Only the clarity.
title.papon.supernova.subtitle: Only his shadow is safe
speech.papon.boss2.p3_god: No more games, amigo. Behold... the POTATO GOD.
speech.papon.boss2.stolen1: My VAN?! Get OUT of my van!!!
speech.papon.boss2.stolen2: Hey, HEY! Who gave YOU the keys?!
speech.papon.boss2.stolen3: That van is a FAMILY heirloom, amigo!
speech.papon.boss2.sky_stolen0: My SKYLINE?! Nobody drives the Skyline but ME!
speech.papon.boss2.sky_stolen1: Careful! That is a COLLECTOR'S ITEM!
speech.papon.boss2.runover0: You hit me... with my OWN van?!
speech.papon.boss2.runover2: Hit and RUN?! In front of my FANS?!
speech.papon.boss2.vangone: Where is my VAN?! Who took my VAN?!
speech.papon.boss2.shield1: Hiding behind a pot lid, amigo?
speech.papon.boss2.ranged0: Arrows? From ALL the way over there? COWARD!
speech.papon.boss2.ranged1: Come closer and say that to my FACE!
speech.papon.boss2.snack0: A snack break? In the middle of MY show?!
speech.papon.boss2.mytaco: Are you eating MY tacos?! In front of ME?!
speech.papon.boss2.potion: Drink up, amigo. You will NEED it.
speech.papon.boss2.lowhp1: Do not die yet! The crowd paid for the WHOLE show!
speech.papon.boss2.kill1: Rest in PEACE... and in SALSA.
speech.papon.boss2.high1: You think you can fly? I INVENTED flying!
speech.papon.boss2.kite0: Where are you GOING? The show is HERE!
speech.papon.boss2.kite1: Running away? There ARE no exits, amigo.
speech.papon.boss2.miss0: Stand STILL, you slippery little potato!
speech.papon.boss2.miss1: Ay, you dance better than my BAND!
speech.papon.boss2.bighit: OOF! Okay... THAT one I felt.
speech.papon.boss2.charm6: Welcome to MY house, amigo. Wipe your feet.
speech.papon.boss2.charm7: Look at all these people... and every SINGLE one came for ME.
speech.papon.boss2.charm8: Wave to the cameras, amigo! Oh, sorry... they are all pointed at ME.
speech.papon.boss2.charm9: SOLD OUT! Every night! Because of ME!
speech.papon.boss2.landed2: Did you SEE that?! Replay! REPLAY!
speech.papon.boss2.hit2: Hey! Not in front of my PUBLIC!
speech.papon.boss2.hit3: Lucky shot! The crowd did not even SEE it!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm6: Kneel, amigo. Even the sun bows to me now.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm7: I was a chef. Now... I am a GOD.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm8: No more games. No more tacos. Only the END.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_charm9: Pray, little mortal. Pray to the POTATO.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_landed2: THAT is the difference... between a man and a GOD.
speech.papon.boss2.p3_hit2: You scratched a god. How... BRAVE.
speech.papon.band.p3_what: ¿Y ahora qué? What do we DO?!
speech.papon.band.p3_play: ¡Toca! Just PLAY, before he kills us!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_power: Whoa. Whoa, whoa... so much power.
speech.papon.boss2.upgrade: You know what? It's about time I gave this thing an upgrade.
speech.papon.boss2.qte_strong: Ay! You're stronger than you look, amigo!
speech.papon.boss2.qte_weak: Shh, shh... just let it happen.
speech.papon.boss2.tango_bad: Two left feet, amigo. Two left feet.
speech.papon.boss2.duel_good: Not bad, amigo. Not bad at all!
speech.papon.boss2.duel_bad: Is that a guitar, or a broom?!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_sombrero: Hats off to the champion... that's me!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_volcan: Even the earth dances for me!
speech.papon.boss2.p3_calaveras: My ancestors would love to meet you, amigo.
item.papon.skyline_fob.tooltip: Recycled out of an old weak minivan. RB26, twin turbos, purple underglow.
item.papon.skyline_fob.tooltip2: Press it to call the Skyline to you (sneak to bring it from wherever it is), again to start the engine from afar. Use on the ground to park it there; sneak-use on it to pocket it.
message.papon.fob_out_of_range: *chirp* ...the Skyline is too far away to hear it.
message.papon.fob_recall: *chirp chirp* The Skyline comes when called.
title.papon.muertos.subtitle: DE LOS MUERTOS
message.papon.die_glocke.on: The drums spin up. Something in the air turns violet.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_martillo: Feel the weight of ten thousand years!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_luna: Luna, my love... show them your light.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_gigante: Wake up, old friend! Rise, GIGANTE!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_grieta: The souls are hungry tonight, amigo. Can you hear them calling you?
speech.papon.boss2.p4_velas: Light a candle for yourself, amigo. You are going to need it.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_danza: My ancestors want to dance with you!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm0: Every year they leave me flowers. This year, I will leave some for you.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm1: The dead know how to party, amigo!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm2: Ten thousand years of fiestas, and you are the best one yet.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm3: Don't be scared. Death is just a very long siesta.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm4: Listen to them. Even the dead are cheering for me.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm5: Bones don't break, amigo. They dance!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_hit1: You can't kill what is already dead!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_landed1: Say hello to my ancestors for me.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_landed2: Olé! The dead love that one!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_howgot: Do you want to know how I got this scar?
speech.papon.boss2.p4_ignis: He gave it to me, a long time ago. I remember he did a little damage... but nothing notable.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_met: I assume you two have met before, no?
speech.papon.boss2.p4_years: Ten thousand years, amigo. Ten thousand years I have been waiting for this moment.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_prophecy: After all this time... the prophecy might finally be fulfilled.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_lunaknows: Ha... la luna knows it too.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_brethren: My brothers, my sisters... this is it. This is the night we were made for.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_grant: So lend me your souls, and grant me your STRENGTH!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_halfbaked: You know... it's not right to go into a fight half baked.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_honor: Señores... it has been an honor, every single night. But I need you to play one last song for me.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_twirl: Ha ha! I still got it!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_goodtime: Come on! Show me a GOOD time!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_flechas: The arrows of the sun never miss!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm6: Ten thousand years I waited, and the prophecy sent me you? I love it.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm7: The old gods are watching, amigo. Give them a show!
title.papon.guardian.subtitle: THE FINAL GUARDIAN
speech.papon.band.p4_honor_a: Compadre... it has been an honor to be a mariachi in this life.
speech.papon.band.p4_honor_b: El honor fue mío, hermano. Every single night.
speech.papon.band.p4_honor_c: Then let the last one be the best one. ¡Vámonos!
hud.papon.giant.laser.hint: Break its line of sight: the beams follow you
hud.papon.giant.laser_live.hint: Keep moving: the beams burn where they land
hud.papon.giant.swipe.hint: Get out of the marked band, or it will throw you at the wall
hud.papon.giant.slam.hint: Leave the pillar of light before the hand lands
hud.papon.giant.slam2.hint: Both hands: leave the pillars, then jump the rings
hud.papon.giant.grab.hint: RUN: it reaches across the whole arena for the red pillar
hud.papon.giant.lunge.hint: Get out of the lane it tears through
hud.papon.giant.stomp.hint: Out from under its foot before it comes down
subtitles.papon.boss.giant_tell_swipe: El Gigante winds up a sweep
speech.papon.boss2.p4_throne: You see that throne up there? I never sat on it to rule. I sat on it to keep it warm.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_carved: The oldest potatoes carved it in stone, before the first sun ever rose.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_warrior: One day a warrior would come, strong enough to beat the last guardian of this world, and take the throne, and carry the whole world on their back.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_moctezuma: I have seen this before, you know. When the iron men came across the sea, my old friend Moctezuma looked at their captain and saw a god. The Feathered Serpent, come home at last.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_gates: So he opened his gates. He gave them his gold, his city, his throne... and they took everything.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_mistake: I will not make his mistake. I will not give you my throne. If you are the one the prophecy speaks of, then you will have to take it from me.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_feel: Yes... I can feel every one of you. Ten thousand years of your hearts and your songs, burning inside me!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_guardian: I am Papon... the Final Guardian.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_bow: Quetzalcóatl! Kukulcán! Come down, and meet the one who wants my throne!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_dance: This was never a fight, amigo. It is a dance. Keep up with me... or fall.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_ouroboros: Around and around you go, amigo. My serpents have you now, and there is no way out!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_pista: The floor is yours, amigo. Stay on the beat, or burn!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_cempasuchil: Follow the marigolds, amigo. They lead the souls home. Everyone else... drowns.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_castillo: Light the castillo! Every fiesta ends with fireworks!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_tango: You and me, amigo. One last tango, in front of the dead. Try to keep up!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_tango_good: Ooh, look at those feet! Somebody has been practicing!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_tango_bad: No, no, no! You dance like a skeleton with no bones!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_tango_won: And that, amigo, is how a guardian dances.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_tango_lost: You out-danced me? Ha... maybe the prophecy is true after all.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm8: Keep up, amigo! The song doesn't wait for anybody.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm9: Is this the one who will carry the world? Then show me!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm10: Feel the rhythm, amigo. Left, right... and dodge!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_charm11: My throne is right up there. Come and take it, if you can.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_hit3: Yes, yes! That is the strength I have been waiting for!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_hit4: Good! Again! Make the prophecy proud!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_landed3: You stepped on my feet, amigo. Bad idea.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_landed4: Is that the warrior of the prophecy? Get up!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_low: No... not yet. The song is not over yet!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_death: So it was true... The throne is yours now, champion. Take care of them... and keep it warm.
qte.papon.how.7: Dance it back on the beat: W S A D, SPACE to spin
speech.papon.boss2.p4_aliento: Quetzalcóatl, Kukulcán... let them taste the fire of the old gods!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_fusion: Brothers of stone, it is time... become ONE!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_fire0: Careful, amigo. They have not eaten in a thousand years.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_fire1: Mind the fire! It burns all the way down to the soul.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_stage2: Enough! Gigante, Quetzalcóatl, Kukulcán... all of you, with me! No more holding back!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_stage3: No... no, NO! Ten thousand years, and I will NOT fall! Not tonight! Not to YOU!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_juicio: Then let the whole world burn with me! EL JUICIO FINAL!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_juicio_end: Still... standing? Ha... then you really are something, amigo.
speech.papon.boss2.p4_chaos0: I can't hold them back anymore! The dead want you, amigo!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_tzompantli: Rise, skulls of the old gods! Show our guest the way down!
speech.papon.boss2.p4_beso: Muchachas! Give our guest a kiss... a kiss of death.
